integrity: Exact finite field and modular Smith calculations using the embedded reproducible Python scripts. Source access and comparison limitations disclosed; no independent validation represented.
scientific_limitations: The graph critical group is not identified with the K3 Picard, Brauer, or Neron-Severi groups; invariant/coinvariant isomorphism is abstract, not canonical. The full text of the relevant 2019 polar-graph Smith paper was inaccessible despite arXiv and OA attempts and an institutional access attempt needing intervention; historical priority therefore remains uncertain. No independent audit.
title: Frobenius descent of the critical group of the 112-line Hermitian quartic
